contributions.anchor: Column A 'Total this Period' TOTAL CONTRIBUTIONS RECEIVED ($26,148.25) on the p2 Summary Page, which is also the printed 'Total Contributions Received (Sum of subtotals from all Schedule A pages)' on p5 (26,148.25)
contributions.detail: 36 rows across the two contribution ledgers sum to 26,148.25 exactly = the cover's PROMOTED per-period cell Column A. The page-subtotal gate closes twice, independently: the p4 attachment's 26 rows sum to 14,250.00 = its own handwritten 'subT. $14,250.00', and the p5 Schedule A page's 10 rows sum to 11,898.25 = its own printed 'Subtotal for this page'; 14,250.00 + 11,898.25 = 26,148.25. That double closure is also what settles the one overwritten amount (Raymond Beckham, read 500 or 600): only 500.00 makes the p4 subtotal, and arithmetic closure outranks the glyph. COLUMN B IS ENTIRELY BLANK on this filing (the filer entered no year-to-date figures at all), so no cumulative reading was available or needed - the anchor is the per-period cell, as the regime requires.

expenditures.anchor: Column A 'Total this Period' TOTAL EXPENDITURES MADE ($21,549.12) on the p2 Summary Page, equal to the typed ledger's own 'Total' line on p9 (21549.12)
expenditures.detail: 67 rows across the three typed ledger pages sum to 21,549.12 exactly = the ledger's own printed Total = the cover's Column A. Per page: p7 26 rows = 9,168.89; p8 28 rows = 10,987.16; p9 13 rows = 1,393.07. Neither p7 nor p8 prints a page subtotal - the ledger totals once, on p9 - so the gate here is the grand total, and it closes to the cent. Column B YTD is blank, as on the contribution side. The p2 ladder is internally consistent: line 3 (a slashed zero) + line 4 (26,148.25) = line 5 (26,148.25); 26,148.25 - line 6 (21,549.12) = line 7 (4,599.13).

in_kind_convention: not applicable - no row on either ledger is marked in-kind and neither ledger prints an in-kind column, so the monetary-only and monetary-plus-in-kind conventions give the identical sums (26,148.25 / 21,549.12) and both close on Column A. Both conventions were tested rather than inherited, because two other filings in this same chunk (Thompson 2010 x2) do fold in-kind into Column A.
escalation_note: (1) p4 row 9 (Raymond Beckham) - the amount is written over itself and reads 500 or 600 at any resolution; the page's own subtotal (14,250.00 less the other 25 rows = 500.00) decides it, and no glyph re-read was allowed to override that. (2) p4 row 10 - the surname is the least legible entry on the page and the month digit of its date is overwritten; a 700 dpi column crop gave 'Sherman Young' as the best reading, recorded at LOW confidence with needs_review=1 rather than asserted. (3) BAND IDENTIFICATION on three pages (p4, p7, p9): 900 dpi crops of the first detected band proved it to be a header row on p4 and p7, and on p9 proved the first rule to be the BOTTOM of row 1 (the band rendered the SECOND entry), so p9's row 1 was extrapolated one pitch up and re-proved. Without those crops every row index on those pages would have been off by one.

4.measure_note: LANDSCAPE ATTACHMENT, and a BOXED grid rather than the legacy underline form, so a row sits BETWEEN its own rules (no one-pitch extrapolation here). Poppler renders it landscape (2197x1699) with rows still advancing top-to-bottom, hence axis 'y'. rowbands.py (200 dpi, skew +0.5) returns 28 horizontal rules from 9.32 to 92.85 at a pitch of ~3.1 and NO vertical rules (the scan's box rules are too light for the fill threshold), so the column bands below were calibrated from crops instead and only the five columns this record actually draws on are declared: Date 2.50-8.60, Name 8.60-20.90, City 61.10-65.90, State 65.90-68.70, Contribution Amount 89.60-98.20. The Organization / Address / ZIP / Phone bands are deliberately NOT declared - no row value is taken from them and the address and phone columns are never carried. BAND IDENTIFICATION: the first band [9.32,11.67] proved to be the HEADER row - a 900 dpi crop of it rendered 'mber | Contribution A' - so data row 1 starts at 11.67. TWO-CROP PROOF at 900 dpi: the FIRST row box pct:89.6,11.67,8.6,3.06@p4 rendered the typed '2,000.00' (recorded 2000.00) and the LAST row box pct:89.6,89.72,8.6,3.13@p4 rendered the handwritten '500.' with raised '00' (recorded 500.00, Stephen G. Stewart). A control crop of the row-25 band rendered '1000.00' (National Land Investments), so the 26 bands are not shifted.

5.measure_note: This is a SECOND Schedule A FORM page (the filer's page box reads '2 of 2'), i.e. the legacy underline grid, not an attachment. rowbands.py (200 dpi, skew +0.0) returns 17 per-column underline rules from 20.94 at a regular pitch of 3.91, whose 4 segments are the column bands (Date 6.36-17.54, Name 19.01-51.50, Address 52.91-79.69, Amount 81.05-88.82; the stored `cell` is widened to 90.00 because several figures' raised cents overrun the printed underline). THE TEXT SITS ABOVE ITS UNDERLINE, so row N spans [rule N-1, rule N] and row 1 is extrapolated one pitch up (20.94 - 3.91 = 17.03). TWO-CROP PROOF at 900 dpi: the FIRST row box pct:81.05,17.03,9.0,3.91@p5 rendered '150.' with raised '00' (recorded 150.00) and the LAST row box pct:81.05,52.23,9.0,3.91@p5 rendered '200.' with raised '00' (recorded 200.00, Larry & Linda Ellertson). A control crop of the row-8 band rendered '250.' (Select Health / Mike Mann).

7.measure_note: TYPED LANDSCAPE EXPENDITURE LEDGER, a fully BOXED grid: rowbands.py (200 dpi, skew +0.0) returns 6 vertical rules at 2.00 / 10.74 / 32.13 / 56.96 / 90.30 / 98.54 - which ARE the column bands (Date Paid, Name, Address, Purpose/Items, Amount) - and 28 horizontal rules from 9.56 to 94.29 at a ~3.14 pitch. A row sits BETWEEN its own rules. BAND IDENTIFICATION: a 900 dpi crop of the first band [9.56,12.71] rendered the printed word 'Amount', i.e. the HEADER row, so data row 1 starts at 12.71. TWO-CROP PROOF at 900 dpi: pct:90.3,12.71,8.24,3.12@p7 rendered '71.72' (recorded 71.72, Intermountain Blueprint) and pct:90.3,87.99,8.24,3.15@p7 rendered '700.00' (recorded 700.00, row 25 Gary Rogers), which pins both ends of the 26-row band list.

8.measure_note: Continuation of the typed landscape ledger; same boxed grid (v-rules 2.14 / 10.83 / 32.27 / 57.08 / 90.44 / 98.63) with 30 horizontal rules from 2.35 to 93.44. This page carries NO header row - the table continues from p7 - so data row 1 is the first band. TWO-CROP PROOF at 900 dpi: pct:90.44,2.35,8.19,3.18@p8 rendered '109.63' (recorded 109.63, Home Depot) and pct:90.44,87.14,8.19,3.12@p8 rendered '29.22' (recorded 29.22, Lowes sign pounder). The band BELOW the last row ([90.26,93.44]) is a stray printed header ('Date Received | First Name | Last Name / Organization | Address | City') left over from the contributions template - it holds no entry and is not transcribed.

9.measure_note: Final page of the typed landscape ledger; same boxed grid. rowbands.py returns 28 horizontal rules from 5.59, but here the FIRST rule is the BOTTOM of row 1, not its top - the page begins mid-table and its top box edge was not detected. A 900 dpi crop of [5.59,8.71] rendered '150.00', which is the SECOND entry (Leo Lines), proving the shift; row 1 is therefore extrapolated one pitch up (5.59 - 3.12 = 2.47) and pct:90.28,2.47,8.22,3.12@p9 rendered '114.91' (recorded 114.91, Home Depot). LAST-ROW PROOF: pct:90.28,40.17,8.22,3.15@p9 is row 13 and the band below it, pct:90.28,43.32,8.22,3.15@p9, rendered '21549.12' - the ledger's own Total line, which is the reconciliation anchor and is deliberately NOT transcribed as an entry.

notes: PAGE-FACE CANDIDATE: 'Gary J Anderson' - index.csv names NO candidate for this row; the page face governs. Party 'Republican'; residence city Springville, UT (the cover prints a street address, deliberately not recorded). ⚠ OFFICE: the page face says only 'County Commissioner' - NO SEAT LETTER - while index.csv carries 'County Commission Seat A' from the acquisition channel's own path. The seat is NOT inferred onto the page face here; both facts are recorded and neither is adjudicated. THE LARGEST FILING IN THIS CHUNK and structurally the most complex: 9 pages, each classified from its own printed header - p1 COVER ('Seven days preceding the Primary Election' checked, amendment 'No', signed 6/15/10, clerk stamp JUN 15 PM 4:14), p2 SUMMARY PAGE (its own printed header; page box '1 of 1'), p3 SCHEDULE A form page ('1 of 3') carrying NO entries and no subtotal - only the filer's pointer 'See attached pages (2)', p4 the first contributions ATTACHMENT (a landscape, boxed, mostly handwritten grid headed 'CONTRIBUTIONS', hand-annotated 'Schedule A' and 'Page 1 of 2', ending in a handwritten 'subT. $14,250.00'), p5 a SECOND SCHEDULE A FORM PAGE ('2 of 2') with 10 entries, its own printed subtotal 11,898.25 and the grand 'Total Contributions Received' 26,148.25, p6 SCHEDULE B form page ('1 of 4') again carrying only the pointer 'See attached pages (3)', and p7-p9 the TYPED landscape expenditure ledger headed 'EXPENDITURES' with the campaign name 'Gary Anderson for Commissioner' written across the top of p7, ending in a 'Total' line of 21549.12 on p9. The two pointer pages (p3, p6) are counted as read and are the reason itemized_pages_A/B name the attachment pages instead: they are NOT empty schedules - the entries exist, on the attachments the filer refers to. SOURCE PROPERTY THIS BRIEF DID NOT ANTICIPATE: the filer's own attachment ledgers carry columns the county form does not - a separate Organization column and a Phone Number column on the contributions attachment, and a real Purpose/Items column on the expenditure ledger (which is why these expenditure rows carry `purpose` while every other filing in this chunk cannot). The expenditure attachment is also UNREDACTED and prints street addresses and phone numbers throughout; nothing of either is reproduced in this record. Column B (Year-to-Date) is BLANK on both summary lines - this filer reported no cumulative figures at all, which is a documented absence, not an unread cell.
